source.author: cic
source.text: eam prae lubidine negat curare quicquam: quasi vero ipse non propter lubidinem tanta flagitia et faciat et dicat. sic igitur affecto haec adhibenda curatio est, ut et illud quod cupiat ostendatur quam leve, quam contemnendum, quam nihili sit omnino, quam facile vel aliunde vel alio modo perfici vel omnino neglegi possit; abducendus etiam est non numquam ad alia studia sollicitudines curas negotia, loci denique mutatione tamquam aegroti non convalescentes saepe curandus est; etiam novo quidam amore veterem amorem tamquam clavo clavum eiciendum putant; maxume autem admonendus est, quantus sit furor amoris.
source.text_original: eam prae lubidine negat curare quicquam: quasi vero ipse non propter lubidinem tanta flagitia et faciat et dicat. —sic igitur affecto haec adhibenda curatio est, ut et illud quod cupiat ostendatur quam leve, quam contemnendum, quam nihili sit omnino, quam facile vel aliunde vel alio modo perfici vel omnino neglegi  possit; abducendus etiam est non numquam ad alia studia sollicitudines curas negotia, loci denique mutatione tamquam aegroti non convalescentes saepe curandus est; / etiam novo quidam amore veterem amorem tamquam clavo clavum eiciendum putant; maxume autem admonendus est, quantus sit furor amoris.
source.text_english: she says that she cares for nothing because of lust; as though he himself did not both do and say such outrageous things because of lust. So in dealing with a person in this condition, the following treatment should be applied: that the object he desires should be shown to be how slight, how contemptible, how utterly worthless it is, and how easily it can be obtained either from elsewhere or in some other way, or else can be wholly disregarded; he should also sometimes be turned away to other pursuits, anxieties, cares, business; and, finally, he should be treated by a change of place, just as invalids who are not recovering are often cured. Some even think that old love should be driven out by new love, as with one nail another nail is knocked out. But above all he should be reminded how great is the madness of love.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Philosophi saeculi solent amorem ueterem amore nouo quasi clauum clauo expellere.
reuse.text_original: Philosophi saeculi solent amorem ueterem amore nouo quasi clauum clauo expellere.
reuse.text_english: The philosophers of the age are accustomed to drive out old love with new love, as it were, to drive out a nail with a nail.
